# Pteris dentata Forssk.

First published in Fl. Aegypt.-Arab.: CXXIV, 186 (1775)

This species is accepted

The native range of this species is Aegean Islands to Iran and Arabian Peninsula, Africa. It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.
